name: Abend Eden
source:
A young girl lives forever—in a paradise that feels like a prison. But when that fleeting eternity comes to an end, a world is also on the verge of ending...
When a vampire girl living in the modern world meets a witch who dwells in the void between dimensions, a paradigm comes to an end.
translation:
一个年轻的女孩永远生活在一个感觉像监狱的天堂里。但当那转瞬即逝的永恒结束时，世界也濒临终结……
当生活在现代世界的吸血鬼女孩遇到居住在维度之间虚空的女巫时，范式就结束了。
